generalized_source_model.methionine_scope: Never infer terminal reactivity from M. Exploratory M profiles require explicit free terminal evidence and retain unverified source endpoint-convention status.
generalized_source_model.sd_basis: Source algebra fixes mu-3*sigma=0.6 angstrom; SD is a model parameter, not an estimated uncertainty or standard error.

spacer_conventions.DSSO: 10.3 angstrom is the manufacturer spacer-arm convention in MAN0016303 Rev. B.0, page 1. It replaces the legacy 10.1 value; that legacy value is not attributed to this manual. This convention does not calibrate an XP distance distribution.
spacer_conventions.DSBU: 12.5 angstrom is the manufacturer spacer-arm convention in MAN0016303 Rev. B.0, page 1.

reference_geometry.scope: The same reference function may be evaluated for any localized, coordinate-checked pair. It is not calibrated for that pair or reagent. Chemical conflicts are excluded from discovery shortlists.
